title: Mixed comparisons and driving-system behavior
summary: This topic loosely groups comparative comments and brief driving-system observations, with only limited clearly positive feedback and many fragments too context-poor to classify confidently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention easy handling, comfort, and one perception that the vehicle recognizes surrounding cars appropriately.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mix unclear comparisons, pricing and luxury impressions, visibility to others, suspension praise without full context, and brief driver-assistance or handling snippets that do not support a confident sentiment label.

limitations: The sampled fragments are highly heterogeneous and do not form a single coherent aspect without additional context.
Most fragments are very short or incomplete, so sentiment and the underlying vehicle attribute are often not clear.
Some examples appear comparative or refer to driver-assistance behavior, but the snippets are too limited to determine whether the comparison is favorable overall.
